If there isn't enough stock, it raises `InsufficientStock` (defined at `inventory/storage.py:7`). This happens when the SKU doesn't exist or `item.quantity < units`. The check is at line 33, and the exception message at line 34 reads `"{sku}: wanted {units}, have {N}"`, where N is the on-hand quantity or 0 if the SKU is unknown.

Nothing is changed before the raise. The stock decrement (line 35) and the reservation insert (line 36) only run after the check passes, so a failed call leaves both tables untouched.
